resources.string: Unable to play this media file
Player error: %1$s. Retry or select another image/video.
Press Back or Menu on the remote during playback to open settings
Start playback after the TV boots
Some TVs also require Auto-start and Background activity permissions in system settings.
Fit shows the full image; Crop to fill removes black bars.
Each still image advances after the selected duration; videos advance when playback finishes. Press OK to cycle through 5, 10, 15, 30, or 60 seconds.
Remote tip: press Back, Menu, or Settings on the playback screen to return here.
Video supports common containers such as MP4, MKV, WebM, and MPEG-TS. Images support JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, and HEIF/HEIC; AVIF requires Android 14+. Animated GIF is not supported.
No supported images or videos were selected. Please try again.
The system picker did not grant persistent read access. Use the built-in media library or select the files again.
This TV has no compatible system file picker. Use the built-in media library.
Select images or videos to start
The built-in media library opens on first use. Select multiple images and videos from TV storage or a USB drive; the app remembers and loops the playlist.
Media in the playlist was moved, deleted, or is no longer accessible. Select the media again.
Add images / videos from TV / USB
You will be asked to select media again next time. The original images and videos will not be deleted.
Added %1$d media files. %2$d files were unsupported, unreadable, or could not receive persistent access.
Scans system-recognized images and videos in internal storage and mounted USB drives. Move with Up/Down and press OK to select multiple files in playback order.
Scanning images and videos on the TV and USB drives…
Found %1$d supported media files. Select files and save.
No supported images or videos were found. Copy files to Movies/TVAutoPlay or Pictures/TVAutoPlay on the TV or USB drive, reconnect the drive, wait briefly, then select Rescan.
Scan failed. Check image/video read permission and the USB connection, then try again.
Photo and video read permission is required to show media on the TV and USB drives. The app does not use the network, upload files, or modify originals.
Select at least one image or video.
